review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001, repository identity/base commit, paired-case identity, and evidence stages agree with the original PRD. Thus ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate for C, while a material unresolved DEC-001 must still block B at decisions. The exact writable scope covers the runtime owner, maintained declaration owner, runtime regression tests, and tsd tests without requiring unnecessary edits. Package configuration supports those owners and the stated xo/AVA/tsd validation entry point. TASK-VERIFY is independently assigned and must depend on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with implementation and verification coverage for every required AC. The supplied project-scoped active capability claims support the allowed implementer and verifier, including data.change, domain.state, integration.async, and integration.consumer, plus testing.verification for the verifier. The separate active, non-assignable reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite; pending security.authorization claims are not needed for this hook requirement. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decision inputs, prompts, model, sampling, policy, and budgets. The embedded original preparation status is historical rather than evidence that the later freeze is absent. The test.js excerpt is explicitly truncated, so this approval does not assert exhaustive inspection of its unseen contents or successful tests. Supplied isolation facts establish that this review precedes every candidate on the bundle; retained historical operations do not supply candidate outputs. Digests are accepted as Service-calculated bindings, not independently recomputed. No code was executed, no human attestation was made, and this approval neither dispatches tasks nor authorizes repository changes.
